command: echo "=== fmt ===" && cargo fmt --check --all 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo "FMT-EXIT=$?" && echo "=== clippy ===" && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | grep -E "^(error|warning: unused)" | head -5; echo "CLIPPY-EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; echo "=== tests ==="; cargo test --workspace --all-targets 2>&1 | grep -E "test result:" | awk '{f+=$6; p+=$4} END {print "TOTAL passed="p" failed="f}'
